title: Initialize Distances
description: Set the distance to the source node as 0 and all other nodes as infinity. Initialize predecessor array to track shortest paths.

title: Relax All Edges V-1 Times
description: For each edge (u,v) with weight w, check if distance[u] + w < distance[v]. If so, update distance[v] and set predecessor[v] = u. Repeat this process V-1 times where V is the number of vertices.

title: Check for Negative Cycles
description: Perform one more iteration over all edges. If any distance can still be improved, a negative weight cycle exists in the graph, meaning shortest paths are undefined for affected nodes.

title: Reconstruct Shortest Paths
description: Using the predecessor array, trace back from any target node to the source to reconstruct the actual shortest path.
